'''Harmony''' (Japanese: '''ホノカ''' ''Honoka'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN098|Out of Their Elements!]]''. Harmony is a circus performer specializing in {{t|Fire}} types.

Harmony was first seen practicing a performance alongside her {{p|Eevee}} [[nickname]]d Bernice, which she planned to [[Evolution|evolve]] into a {{p|Flareon}} during the next performance. While talking to {{Ash}}, [[Goh]], and [[Chloe]], a [[Thunder Stone]] was accidentally dropped on her Eevee, causing her to evolve into {{p|Jolteon}}. {{OBP|Billy|JN098}}'s Eevee accidentally became a Flareon, so Harmony took him instead but he refused to listen to her commands. While practicing with her other Pokémon, Bernice showed off her {{m|Thunder Shock}} and Harmony was able to come up with a plan which involved Billy and [[Chloe's Eevee]] to do a performance.

After their performance, Harmony provided Chloe with a Fire Stone so that Chloe could evolve her Eevee into a Flareon one day.

She reappeared in a flashback in ''[[JN120|Infinite Possibilities!]]''.

In ''[[JN135|Heroes Unite!]]'', Harmony reappeared in a fantasy, alongside other Trainers Chloe and her Eevee met.
